narrative.overview:
The shop is a book fair floor in full swing that happens to rent. Hall-blue ink sits on a cool white floor, a banner-yellow price flag and a flag-red call to action carry the energy, and five zone colours do the sorting that a template storefront would do with a sidebar. The covers are the shop's real colour; the interface frames them with zone-tinted backing boards, soft shadows and fair objects: a bunting strip, a booth-fascia header, a price tag with a punched hole, a starburst sticker, a hall floor map as category navigation, and a ticket-stub order timeline.

Tone is lively but never childish: Thai-first copy, Prompt at 700 to 800 for banners, prices and labels, Sarabun for reading, generous Thai line height (1.65). Light is the fair by day; dark is the hall after closing, with a deep navy floor, the same five zones lifted for contrast, and yellow staying yellow.
keyCharacteristics: Hall-blue ink and banner yellow carry identity; flag red marks the one action that matters.
Five zone colours (A to E) tint category chips, cover backing boards, headings and charts.
Fully pill-shaped controls over softly rounded (14px) cards.
Soft blue-tinted ambient shadows; depth comes from lift on hover, not from hard edges.
Dashed rules and dotted connectors echo tickets and floor plans.
Light and dark themes are first-class, toggled by data-theme and falling back to prefers-color-scheme.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Flag red marks the single action or price on a screen (accent button, price number, cart count). Everything else clickable is ink.

rules.name: The Zone Is Identity Rule
rules.body: A zone colour appears only on things that belong to that zone (chip, backing board, heading mark, chart bar). Never use a zone hue as generic decoration or status.

rules.name: The Flip Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, filled ink/red/zone surfaces take dark text (#0a1030 or #1a0605), never white.

rules.name: The Price Is Display Rule
rules.body: Money is always Prompt, tabular, heavier than its neighbours.

rules.name: The Soft Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred and tinted with hall blue; no hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Focus Pair Rule
rules.body: Focus is a 3px yellow outline plus a 5px ink ring, so it reads on both yellow-adjacent and dark surfaces.

dos: Do show rent and refundable deposit together before any commitment, using the price tag and the Prompt tabular total.
Do set a zone with .z1 to .z5 and read --zc; tint backing boards at 14% over the card colour.
Do give filled ink, red and zone surfaces dark text in dark mode.
Do keep the yellow-plus-ink focus pair on every interactive element.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion; the rise-in and lift effects are decoration only.
Do use real covers; where none exists use the zone-coloured placeholder with the title.
donts: Don't return to a clean white grid of identical cards under a hero; the floor map, rails and tags are the structure.
Don't use red for anything but the single main action or price on a screen.
Don't use a zone hue for status or decoration; status is ok, warn, bad.
Don't add photographs of a shop, testimonials or sales figures; none exist.
Don't add hard offset shadows or new radii outside the shape set above.
Don't make the interface childish; keep copy short and Thai-first.
